messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming tail p99 spike detected for /v1/streaming endpoints in eu-west-1. p99 ~ 2.9s (baseline ~600ms). Start 2026-03-14T12:12:00Z. Evictions increased x6, slab fragmentation up. Suspected KV cache pressure -> prefill vs decode imbalance.

alex: I'm starting a quick triage. pulling prefill/decode rates and slab stats. tagging @maria @ryan.

maria: seeing huge prefill bursts at ~12:10-12:14. prefill_rate ~= 4x decode_rate for several shards. kv-node-7 and kv-node-9 show high free-slab-runs and small live-object fragments.

ryan: streaming stalls correlate with peaks in prefill backlog + slab resize churn. p95 also rose from 220ms -> 1.1s. p99 is worst.

alex: running quick commands to gather traces and logs:
```
# get eviction rate per shard (internal metrics)
curl -s "https://mon.internal/api/query?m=kv.evictions.count{region=\"eu-west-1\"}" | jq .
# inspect kv node memory/fragmentation
kubectl -n infra exec -it kv-node-7 -- redis-cli info memory | grep -E \"used_memory_human|fragmentation\"
```

maria: sample metrics: 
- shard-7 evictions: 480/min (baseline 70/min)
- prefill queue depth spiked to 12k
- slab fragmentation ratio ~1.9

sam: customers with streaming SSE sessions in eu-west-1 seeing stalls and reconnects. support ticket C-4321 opened; customer report: "multiple reconnects, occasional 502s". Leah is on customer comms.

leah: notified impacted customers (small set of enterprise customers) with ETA for mitigation and link to status page. asking for ETA to share.

alex: short-term mitigations I'm pushing now:
- reduce aggressive prefill multiplier from 4 -> 1.5 for streaming routes (runtime flag)
- scale +1 kv replica for eu-west-1 to absorb prefill traffic
- enable prefill backoff when slab_free < 15%

tina: will rollout runtime flag canary to 5% of traffic in eu-west-1. if no regression in 3m, promote.

ops-bot: deploy bot: canary deploy queued: runtime-prepfill-adjust @tina (canary id: c-8921).

ryan: long-term we should prefer decode-first for in-flight streaming: when prefill backlog > 2k or slab pressure > 75%, route new streaming prefill work to decode path or to a lower-cost read-through fallback. I'll open a design doc.

alex: immediate tests after canary: prefill queue reduced by ~60% on canary nodes, p99 on canary traffic down to ~800ms (still above baseline). canary looks safe. starting rollout to 30%.

maria: log snippet from kv-node-7 around 12:13 UTC: 
```
[12:13:02] WARN kv.prefill: queue_len=11520 slab_free_pct=12.3 evictions=512/min decode_rate=3.2k/s prefill_rate=12.8k/s
[12:13:04] INFO runtime.stream: stall_detected session_id=abcd-1234 tail_latency=2800ms
```

sam: rolling reroute of critical customers to dedicated eu-dedicated-1 pool started (traffic-shift request to router). monitoring for any errors.

leah: customer update sent: "We are mitigating an elevated streaming latency issue; temporary routing mitigations and config changes applied. We'll follow up with RCA."

alex: current live mitigations summary:
- runtime prefill multiplier lowered (canary -> 30% rollout)
- prefill backoff threshold enabled (slab_free < 15%)
- +1 kv replica added to eu-west-1 ring (manual scale)
- critical customers routed to dedicated pool

ops-bot: autoscaler: new kv pod kv-node-12 scheduled in eu-west-1 (pod: kv-node-12).

ryan: I'm going to run a quick simulation to validate decode-first policy doesn't increase token decoding latencies.

maria: watching metrics: after 30% rollout p95 ~ 330ms, p99 ~ 920ms; evictions down ~40% overall in ring. streaming stalls rate down 70% on rolled nodes.

alex: looks like mitigations effective. still monitoring for full ring convergence. will keep routing open until p99 < 700ms for 15m.

ryan: I'll own overnight mitigation & followup. filing handoff: ryan -> oncall-night. planning: 1) finalize decode-first fallback logic, 2) slab defragment job to run off-hours, 3) permanent prefill policy change for streaming.

sam: ops note: if p99 rises again after rollback, immediate rollback of prefill change and scale kv ring further.

leah: closing customer comms loop. next update 30m or on resolution.

alex: handing off incident to @ryan for monitoring and postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, severity reduced to SEV-2. continuing monitoring.
